title: Technical error · application/problem+json (any API → caller)
description: Annex D2-1 (technical errors) lists type, status, title, detail, instance, a reason code and additionalErrors, without key names for the last two. Our key names (reasonCode, additionalErrors[].location/detail) are a choice: INTERPRETATION T10. Sent with HTTP 4xx/5xx; a business rejection is a 201 with status Rejected instead.

type.description: URI identifying the problem type. Ours use the placeholder host digital-euro-simulator.invalid.

status.description: Same value as the HTTP status code.

instance.description: Path of the request that failed.

reasonCode.description: PLACEHOLDER key name (D2-1 says 'reason code'). Values per INTERPRETATION C8.

additionalErrors.description: PLACEHOLDER item structure: one entry per problem found.

location.description: JSON path or header name, e.g. $.paymentInstructionObject.amount
